label: Porch-to-Porch Walk of Defeat
description: Loser jogs a loop to every league member's porch and leaves a handwritten "I lost" card on each doormat, filming the route start to finish. The uncut video goes in the league chat.

label: Okayest Manager Gift Basket
description: Loser buys $10 of groceries the winner lists by text, packs them into a basket with a handwritten "World's Okayest Manager" ribbon, and leaves it on the winner's porch. A photo of the basket goes to the league chat.

label: Winner's Doorstep Jumping Jacks
description: Winner names a number from 10 to 20, and Loser does that many jumping jacks at his own front door in one take. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Formal Citation for the Winner
description: Loser writes a three-paragraph commendation of the winner's lineup in the style of a military citation and reads it in a solemn voice note after bedtime. The voice note goes in the league chat.

label: Bin Boy Week
description: For one week, Loser takes the winner's trash and recycling bins to the curb and back, after the winner presides over a short ceremony and hands him a pillowcase "Bin Boy" sash. A photo of the sash and the bins goes in the league chat.

label: Doorstep Bread Run
description: Loser bakes a loaf of bread from scratch for each league member after bedtime and leaves one on each porch with a note. A photo of each loaf goes in the league chat.

label: 30-Second Lineup Sentencing
description: On a video call the winner presides over, Loser reads a one-line confession of his lineup mistakes in a courtroom voice. A screenshot goes in the group chat.

label: Cardboard Commission
description: Winner names an everyday object under $30, and Loser builds a life-size cardboard-and-tape replica after bedtime. He hands it over with $10 as a "down payment" while the league watches the handoff on video.

label: Winner's Banned Word, $1 a Pop
description: Winner picks one harmless word, and for the week Loser owes the winner $1 every time he types it in the league chat. The winner posts a screenshot of the tally at week's end.

label: Backwards Alphabet Workout
description: Winner names an exercise, and Loser does 30 seconds of it while reciting the alphabet backwards, in one uncut take. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Prop on Late Calls
description: Winner picks a prop under $25, such as a fanny pack or a foam crown. Loser buys it and wears it on three late-night league video calls before the next draft, with a screenshot of each in the group chat.

label: Cold Shower Countdown Ceremony
description: On a video call the winner presides over, Loser finishes his shower with 30 seconds of cold water while the league counts down. He posts a screenshot of himself, dripping, in the group chat.

label: Chore Filed as a Police Report
description: Winner picks one chore at Loser's own home, and Loser films a before-and-after, narrated like a police incident report. Both videos go in the group chat.

label: Handmade Championship Belt
description: Loser makes a cardboard-and-foil championship belt engraved with the winner's name, wears it for a photo with a straight face, then mails it to the winner. The photo goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Weighted Walk
description: Winner picks the load, up to 15 lbs of pantry goods, and a nickname for Loser's name tag. Loser carries the backpack on a two-mile neighborhood walk, and a route screenshot plus a photo of the name tag go in the league chat.

label: Mailbox Travel Commercial
description: After bedtime, Loser films a 60-second travel commercial for his own mailbox in a dramatic announcer voice. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Winner's Team Name Shirt Day
description: Loser tapes the winner's team name on a shirt and wears it all day, including a 10-minute workout. A photo at breakfast and a video of the workout go in the league chat.

label: Week of the Butler Voice
description: For one week, Loser sends every voice note in the league chat in a posh butler voice and opens each with "Master of the League." The voice notes are the proof.

label: 25 Straight Jump-Rope Skips
description: Before the next draft, Loser must land 25 consecutive jump-rope skips, practicing after bedtime. The uncut video of the successful attempt goes in the league chat.

label: Park Cleanup, Winner's Pick
description: The winner names a local park, and Loser spends 30 minutes picking up litter there with gloves and a bag. A photo of the full bag goes in the league chat.

label: Play-by-Play of the Winner's Win
description: Loser films a 60-second sports-broadcast play-by-play of the winner's matchup, complete with crowd noises. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Per My Previous Humiliation
description: For three days, Loser starts every message in the league chat with "Per my previous humiliation," and ends it with the winner's team name. A screenshot of the chat goes in the group chat on day three.

label: Chore Power Rankings
description: Loser posts a ranked top-5 of the household chores he did this week, with a one-line review and a photo of each, in the league chat.

label: Laundry Pyramid for the Pharaoh
description: After bedtime, Loser folds a pile of laundry into a pyramid with a handmade cardboard sign naming the winner Pharaoh. A photo goes in the league chat.
